why: The same font files must be served to the reference capture and shipped in the Compose app, or the diff measures a font difference instead of a port difference. `res/font` is the single source; every other copy is derived from it by `scripts/vendor-fonts.mjs --check`.
notes: Measurements are against `sans` (Inter). `serif` (Instrument Serif) only affects display text, and it is compared too, so a missing serif file is still a failure.

A weight without a file falls back through the browser's own synthesis, which is exactly the kind of invisible difference this manifest exists to prevent: if the prototype asks for weight 700, either vendor a 700 file or stop asking for it.
